title: Getting started
text: Parquet columnar storage file format optimised analytical workloads. Compared SAS files (row-based formats like CSV), Parquet offers: Smaller file size: Efficient compression significantly reduces disk space, especially large datasets. Faster queries: columnar layout speeds analytical queries need subset columns. Wide tool support: Parquet supported across data processing frameworks R, Python, beyond, making easy integrate modern workflows.

code: sas_dir <- fs::path_temp("sas-dir") fs::dir_create(sas_dir)  bef_list <- fastreg::simulate_register(   "bef",   c("", "1999", "1999_1", "2020"),   n = 1000 ) |>   # Randomly (re)generate koen, so we don't rely on any potential future   # changes to the simulated data from osdc.   purrr::map(\(x) {     x |> dplyr::mutate("koen" = sample(c(1, 2), 1000, replace = TRUE))   })  lmdb_list <- fastreg::simulate_register(   "lmdb",   c("2020", "2021"),   n = 1000 )  fastreg::save_as_sas(   c(bef_list, lmdb_list),   sas_dir ) #> sas-dir #> ├── bef.sas7bdat #> ├── bef1999.sas7bdat #> ├── bef1999_1.sas7bdat #> ├── bef2020.sas7bdat #> ├── lmdb2020.sas7bdat #> └── lmdb2021.sas7bdat
